channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ministros de Lula apostam que Moraes estenderá domiciliar de Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula’s government ministers believe that Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes will extend the house arrest of Jair Bolsonaro, whose current order expires on June 25. This expectation stems from the assessment that Moraes views Bolsonaro’s health as delicate and wishes to avoid a decision that could be exploited by the right as electoral ammunition. Bolsonaro has been under house arrest since March, and the measure is set for review after 90 days, as Moraes himself ordered.

item.title: Líder do PSB quer França candidato em SP contra Tarcísio e Haddad
item.description: The leader of the PSB in the Chamber of Deputies, Jonas Donizette, advocates for Márcio França’s candidacy for governor of São Paulo in 2026, arguing it could prevent a first-round decision and strengthen the party. He notes França’s experience as former governor, knowledge of the interior, and strong polling numbers, while highlighting that recent withdrawals by other candidates create an opening for a PSB-run campaign. Donizette also emphasized the need for President Lula to mediate the situation, given São Paulo’s strategic importance to Lula’s re-election bid.

item.title: Reunião entre Lula e Jaques pode definir futuro de líder do governo no Senado
item.description: Jaques Wagner, the government leader in the Senate, is set to meet with President Lula to discuss his political future following a PF operation. He is expected to step down to shield Lula’s re-election campaign and focus on his legal defense. Before meeting Lula, Wagner will thank Senate President Davi Alcolumbre for his public support after the operation.

item.title: Lula é rejeitado por 47% dos eleitores, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Gerp poll released on June 24, 2026 shows that 47% of voters reject President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), making him the most rejected presidential candidate. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) follows with 44% rejection. The survey interviewed 2,000 people from June 15–20, with a 2.19 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level, registered with the TSE under BR-09657/2026.

item.title: “Mulheres são fortes, não vítimas”, diz Daniella Marques
item.description: Daniella Marques, former president of Caixa and advisor to Paulo Guedes, rejects the victimization narrative of women and advocates for economic freedom, entrepreneurship, and stricter public security as central to Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 pre-campaign. She argues that women’s real life is economic and that security policy must protect victims, not aggressors. Lula leads among women, while Flávio has an edge among men, making the female vote decisive in the election.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 50% e aprovado por 43%, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Gerp poll released on June 24, 2026 shows that 50% of voters disapprove of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government, while 43% approve. The administration's evaluation reveals 42.9% rate it as 'bad' or 'terrible', 34.3% as 'good' or 'excellent', and 20.4% as 'regular'. The survey interviewed 2,000 people nationwide from June 15–20, 2026, with a margin of error of ±2.19 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Flávio e Lula empatam no 2º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) are technically tied in a simulated second-round presidential race, with 42% and 40% of voting intentions, respectively, within the 2.19-point margin of error. The poll also shows a technical tie in the first round, with Lula at 37% and Bolsonaro at 34%. Conducted by Gerp from June 15–20, 2026, among 2,000 respondents nationwide, the survey is registered with the TSE under BR-09657/2026.

item.title: Renan Santos: ‘bolsonarismo morreu’ e Flávio é inviável na disputa contra Lula
item.description: Renan Santos, pre-candidate for the Missão party, claimed that bolsonarism is dead and that Flávio Bolsonaro is unviable as an alternative to Lula. He advocates reforming Bolsa Família with incentives for labor market integration, especially in the Northeast, and proposes tough measures against organized crime, including the 'enemy criminal law' and state of defense. On the economy, he criticizes tax exemptions, cites Manaus Free Trade Zone for review, and proposes a pension reform based on a trigger to raise the minimum retirement age and review of exceptions for public servants.

item.title: Defesa da AtlasIntel avalia levar caso de pesquisa barrada ao STF
item.description: AtlasIntel's defense expects the TSE to uphold the release of the poll showing declining support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, but says it may take the case to the STF if the suspension remains. Minister Nunes Marques suspended the poll following PL claims that the methodology induced negative perceptions, while the Electoral Prosecutor's Office opposed the suspension.

item.title: Após pressão, Lula deve definir futuro de Jaques Wagner nesta 4ª
item.description: Lula is set to meet with Jaques Wagner this Wednesday to determine the senator’s future as Senate government leader, following Wagner’s inclusion in Operation Compliance Zero investigating Banco Master. Despite government allies pressuring him to step down to avoid political damage, Wagner resists and insists on negotiating his exit solely with Lula, proposing a leave to focus on his defense and 2026 Senate re-election bid, without admitting guilt in the investigation.

item.title: TSE discute restringir uso de vídeo e áudio em questionários de pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is discussing proposals to restrict the use of video and audio in electoral poll questionnaires, aiming to reduce the risk of manipulating voter responses. The measure seeks to enhance the transparency and reliability of opinion polls during the electoral period.

item.title: Saiba quem são os pré-candidatos ao governo e senado de Rondônia
item.description: In Rondônia, seven pre-candidates have been identified for the state governor race and eleven for the Federal Senate in the 2026 elections. The names are not yet official, as party conventions will take place between June 20 and August 5, according to the TSE calendar. During the pre-campaign phase, candidates may disclose proposals, attend events, and seek political support, but cannot directly solicit votes.

item.title: Gil do Vigor vai participar do 'Mais você' diretamente dos EUA nesta quinta
item.description: Gil do Vigor will appear on the 'Mais você' program this Thursday (25) live from the United States, where he will comment on the Scotland vs Brazil match in the 2026 World Cup. The match will take place this Wednesday (24) at 7:00 PM Brasília time at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami, as the final group stage match. The article also references related content about players' partners who are actresses and memes from the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Lula e Jaques Wagner devem se reunir e tratar de saída do senador da liderança do governo para conter dano eleitoral
item.description: President Lula is expected to meet with Senator Jaques Wagner this Wednesday to discuss Wagner’s potential resignation from the government leadership in the Senate following a Federal Police investigation into alleged undue advantages received from Banco Master. Allies say Wagner’s departure is necessary to mitigate electoral damage, shift focus from the scandal, and protect Lula’s re-election campaign and upcoming events in Bahia, though Wagner resists, citing his 40-year friendship with Lula and claiming his stay does not harm his own re-election bid.

item.title: Segunda Turma do STF, que tem apoiado Mendonça no caso Master, vai analisar pedido de Jaques Wagner para anular operação da PF
item.description: The Second Chamber of the STF will review the defense's request by Senator Jaques Wagner to annul the police search and seizure in the Master case, initially authorized by Minister André Mendonça. Mendonça is likely to refer the appeal to the full chamber, which has consistently upheld his rulings in this investigation. Wagner is alleged to have received improper economic benefits from Banco Master, allegedly mediated by Augusto Lima, former partner of Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Trump compartilha artigo que cita eleição no Brasil como "grande teste"
item.description: Trump shared a NewsMax opinion article describing Brazil's 2026 presidential election as the 'next major test' of the conservative wave in Latin America. The piece claims Bolsonaro supporters are rallying behind Flávio Bolsonaro to unseat leftist President Lula, and that a right-wing victory in Brazil would dramatically reshape the region's political landscape.

item.title: Ancelotti confirma Neymar relacionado contra Escócia: "De volta"
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti confirmed that Neymar is available for the match against Scotland in the 2026 World Cup, marking his return to the Brazilian national team after over two years sidelined due to injury. The coach praised the player's recovery, professional attitude during rehabilitation, and said Neymar can contribute both on and off the field. This will be Neymar's first appearance for the Seleção since October 2023, when he suffered a serious knee injury against Uruguay.

item.title: Lula precisa de um momento Messi
item.description: Lula faces declining approval in polls, with 50% disapproval in Ipec and 38% rating his government as poor in Datafolha. The Messi analogy — missing a penalty but scoring two goals to win the match — suggests Lula needs a turning-point moment to recover his political capital before the October 2026 elections.

item.title: Jaques Wagner vai a Brasília e tenta convencer Lula a mantê-lo na liderança até o recesso
item.description: Senate government leader Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) travels to Brasília on Wednesday (24) to persuade President Lula to retain him in office until at least the start of the recess on July 19, despite facing potential removal. He aims to ensure continuity in the government’s political coordination during the critical period before the legislative break.

item.title: Lula aproveita palanque frágil de Flávio Bolsonaro para intensificar agendas no Rio
item.description: President Lula (PT) is intensifying his agenda in Rio de Janeiro to exploit the weakening of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) local political base. The Workers' Party strategy aims to capitalize on the bolsonarista group's decline to strengthen federal presence and influence the 2026 state political landscape.

item.title: Cabo Daciolo transfere domicílio para o Amazonas mirando candidatura à presidência
item.description: Cabo Daciolo, former federal deputy and presidential candidate in the 2018 and 2022 elections, had his electoral domicile transferred to Presidente Figueiredo, Amazonas, approved by the TRE-AM. The move aims to meet the residency requirement for running for president in 2026, as the Brazilian Constitution requires candidates to have held electoral domicile in the country for at least two years prior to the election.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro pede prorrogação de prisão domiciliar para o ex-presidente; prazo termina nesta quinta
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro requested an extension of house arrest from Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, citing ongoing health issues requiring specialized medical monitoring. The current 90-day period ends this Thursday (25), and the defense argues that observed clinical improvement does not negate the humanitarian grounds for the initial measure. Bolsonaro remains under electronic ankle monitor with restrictions including bans on cell phones, social media, and public demonstrations near his residence.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que vai aos EUA contra nova tarifa
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro announced he will travel to the United States to oppose a potential 25% tariff proposed by the Trump administration on Brazilian exports, calling the measure unfair and harmful to Brazilian companies. He also criticized the Lula administration for failing to meet European Union sanitary requirements, which resulted in Brazil’s removal from the list of authorized exporters of beef, poultry, horse meat, tripe, fish, and honey due to insufficient documentation on antimicrobial use in livestock.

item.title: “Todo mundo tem direito à opinião”, diz Nikolas sobre Zema
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) defended the right to opinion in response to criticisms from former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) regarding audio and message exchanges between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and former banker Daniel Vorcaro. Nikolas stated that 'everyone has the right to an opinion,' downplaying Zema's concerns about the nature of the conversations.

item.title: Após visita a Trump, Flávio diz que volta aos EUA para frear tarifaço
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced he will travel to the U.S. on July 6 to participate in hearings before the International Trade Commission and attempt to block a proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian exports, following his meeting with Donald Trump that preceded the USTR’s recommendation. He argued Brazil is already the most taxed country in the world and that another surcharge would be unfair to domestic companies.

item.title: A ofensiva de Flávio Bolsonaro nos EUA após desgaste com novo tarifaço
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro sought to participate in a U.S. public hearing on a potential 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, but according to VEJA columnist Diogo Schelp, the move has little commercial weight and is primarily aimed at mitigating political damage from his May meeting with Donald Trump, which fueled perceptions he acted against Brazil’s interests. The initiative is seen as an attempt to 'clear his name' amid allegations he contributed to the tariff threat.

item.title: Rotular organizações criminosas gera confusão e não desmantela facções, diz ministro de Lula
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira stated that labeling criminal organizations as terrorists creates international confusion and fails to dismantle gangs, advocating for bilateral cooperation with the U.S. instead of unilateral measures. He emphasized that organized crime respects no borders and requires coordination among police, intelligence, and mutual legal assistance among OEA member states.

item.title: Prerrogativas atuará na coordenação de campanha de Haddad
item.description: Lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, from the Prerrogativas group, has been appointed to coordinate the articulation between Lula’s national campaign and Fernando Haddad’s statewide bid in São Paulo, stepping down from leading the presidential campaign’s legal team. His role reinforces the PT’s strategy of using Haddad’s candidacy as an additional platform for Lula in the country’s largest electoral college. Carvalho, a longtime critic of Operation Car Wash and close to the Lula administration, had previously supported Simone Tebet’s Senate bid in 2026.

item.title: ‘Radioterapia mais moderna do que aquela que faço’, diz Lula sobre novo aparelho no SUS
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva praised the new high-tech radiotherapy accelerator delivered to Santa Marcelina Hospital in São Paulo, stating it is far more modern than the equipment used in his own treatment for basal cell carcinoma on the head. The R$ 7.3 million investment enables up to 1,000 radiotherapy treatments annually, offering greater precision and sparing healthy tissue, as part of the SUS’s Agora Tem Especialistas program.

item.title: Gilmar encaminha garantias à AGU para extradição de Zambelli
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes sent information to the AGU to support the extradition request of former deputy Carla Zambelli to Italy, related to her conviction for illegal firearm possession and illegal coercion with a firearm. The decision, signed on June 23, comes ahead of the July 1 ruling by Rome's Court of Cassation on a second extradition request. Zambelli was sentenced to 5 years and 3 months in prison for events occurring on the eve of the 2022 elections and has been free since May 22 after Italy denied extradition in another case.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede para participar de audiência nos EUA sobre tarifas contra o Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) requested to participate in a USTR-organized public hearing in the U.S. regarding proposed 25% tariffs on Brazilian exports. He claims he would better defend Brazil’s interests than President Lula, opposing the tariffs and advocating for a negotiated solution. The request follows 40% punitive tariffs imposed in 2025 and his recent meeting with Donald Trump at the White House.

item.title: Aprovação de Lula chega a 44%, segundo pesquisa
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's approval rating reached 44%, with 32% rating his administration as good or excellent, according to an Ipsos-Ipec survey conducted from June 13 to 17, 2026. Disapproval decreased to 50%, still exceeding approval, with 38% viewing the government as bad or terrible. Support is strongest among Northeastern voters, those with lower education and low income, while rejection is highest among Bolsonaro voters, evangelicals, the highly educated, and high-income groups, particularly in the Southeast, South, and North/Central-West regions.

item.title: TSE determina nova eleição para Prefeitura de Itaguaí (RJ)
item.description: The TSE upheld the disqualification of Rubem Vieira de Souza (Podemos) as a mayoral candidate in Itaguaí (RJ) due to serving a third consecutive term, which is unconstitutional, and ordered a new election for mayor and vice-mayor. The TRE-RJ must set the date for the supplementary election, either on October 4 (concurrent with general elections) or November 8, 2026, as per TSE Ordinance No. 567/2025. The office is currently held on an interim basis by Haroldo Jesus (PDT), president of the Municipal Chamber.

item.title: Zema sugere mudanças no Bolsa Família e fala em ‘geração de imprestáveis’
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema criticized younger generations for allegedly lacking work ethic, using the term 'unemployable generation' at a CNI event. He also proposed changes to the Bolsa Família program, sparking debate on social media between supporters and critics.

item.title: TSE mantém multa a prefeita e vice eleitos de Pilar (AL) por propaganda eleitoral irregular
item.description: The TSE unanimously upheld a R$10,000 fine against elected mayor Maria de Fátima Resende Rocha Oiticica and vice-mayor Tayronne Henrique dos Santos for irregular electoral propaganda in the 2024 municipal elections, due to the use of an electronic panel with outdoor-like effects during a rally. Relator Minister André Mendonça emphasized that the equipment continuously displayed the campaign slogan and candidate numbers with sufficient visibility to resemble paid outdoor advertising.

item.title: Oposição vai a Washington debater taxas comerciais enquanto Planalto adota via bilateral
item.description: The federal government chose not to send representatives to a U.S. Congress public hearing on trade tariffs, preferring a bilateral approach. Meanwhile, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed his participation and will speak at the American forum, representing the opposition. This highlights a divergence between the Executive and opposition sectors regarding the strategy for commercial negotiations with the United States.

item.title: Lula diz que mulher agradeceu por prótese do SUS: “Beijando como nunca”
item.description: President Lula praised the Unified Health System (SUS) by sharing a woman’s gratitude for free dental prostheses, saying she now kisses "like never before" after the procedure. He emphasized the importance of free dental care in ensuring dignity and quality of life for all Brazilians. At the event in São Paulo, the government also announced investments in medical equipment, including a high-tech linear accelerator and 20 MRI machines, and accredited Hospital Santa Marcelina as a Level 1 Teaching Hospital.

item.title: Trump reposta artigo que define as eleições brasileiras como ‘próximo teste’ para sua influência na América Latina
item.description: Trump shared on his Truth Social platform a Newsmax article framing Brazil's October elections as the 'next major test' of his political influence in Latin America, emphasizing debates over the integrity of the Brazilian electoral system. The article links Colombia's recent conservative victory to a broader rightward shift in the region, positioning Brazil as a potential turning point in this political transformation. The post comes amid strained relations between Trump and Brazilian President Lula, following recent criticisms by the former U.S. president of the PT leader.

item.title: Planalto se prepara para receber mais denúncias contra ‘República da Bahia’ e blindar Lula
item.description: The Planalto Palace is preparing for new Federal Police investigations into the so-called 'Bahia Republic', involving former minister Rui Costa and Senator Jaques Wagner, linked to alleged bribes in consigned credit operations and fraudulent pandemic respirator purchases. As the PT seeks to shield Lula, investigations reveal ties between Flávio Bolsonaro and Banco Master, intensifying pressure on government allies. Wagner is set to meet with Lulu to discuss his potential resignation.

item.title: Sóstenes diz ter acionado embaixada dos EUA após vídeo em que relacionou PT a facções
item.description: PL party leader in the Chamber of Deputies, Sóstenes Cavalcante (RJ), said he sent a letter to the U.S. Embassy in Brazil after being forced to remove a video linking the PT to criminal factions without evidence. The removal was ordered by TSE Vice President André Mendonça, who ruled that the phrase 'there are strong suspicions' still conveyed misinformation despite its cautious framing. Sóstenes stated he approached the embassy to have the U.S. government publicly clarify whether such suspicions about financing of left-wing parties by criminal groups in Latin America exist.

item.title: MP Eleitoral pede ao TSE para assumir recurso contra Dr. Furlan
item.description: The Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office requested the TSE to assume responsibility for the appeal challenging the re-election of former Macapá mayor Dr. Furlan (PSD), after former Senator Gilvam Borges withdrew his appeal. The MPE argues the case involves public interest and electoral legitimacy, despite previously opposing the appeal due to insufficient evidence of political or economic abuse in the Macapá Summer 2024 event.

item.title: Lula entrega aparelhos de radioterapia em São Paulo
item.description: President Lula delivered a modern linear accelerator for radiotherapy at Santa Marcelina Hospital in São Paulo, increasing treatment capacity by 30% and reducing the time to start treatment from 45 to 10 days. The equipment is part of a national package of 105 devices distributed over the last three years, with additional investments in CT scanners and health agreements totaling R$ 166.7 million for the SUS. Simultaneous deliveries in Fortaleza and Sinop underscored the strategy to decentralize cancer care, reduce patient travel, and expand access to treatment.

item.title: Lula diz que radioterapia inaugurada em SP supera a que usou em BSB
item.description: President Lula stated that the high-tech linear accelerator delivered to Hospital Santa Marcelina in São Paulo is more modern than the equipment he used during his 15 preventive radiotherapy sessions in Brasília following basal cell lesion removal. He noted that 90% of the hospital’s services will be via the SUS and announced R$ 166.7 million in health investments, including 20 MRI machines, during an event attended by federal officials.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes defende condenação de Zambelli por perseguição armada e envia garantias à Itália
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes has sent guarantees to Brazil's Attorney General's Office requested by Italy for a possible extradition of former deputy Carla Zambelli, defending the validity of her conviction for armed persecution in São Paulo in 2022. The conviction, approved by a large majority (9-2 for illegal firearm possession and 10-1 for illegal coercion), was deemed regular and free of procedural flaws by Mendes, who assured the sentence would be served at the Brasília Women's Penitentiary and that Zambelli would have access to lawyers, family, and Italian diplomatic representation. Italy is set to rule on a new extradition request on July 1 related to this same conviction.

item.title: “Ganhamos cinco das seis” eleições, diz Dirceu
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu (PT) expressed optimism about President Lula's (PT) re-election in the October elections, stating the PT had 'won five of the six' previous elections. He criticized the Bolsonaro family's relationship with Donald Trump, claiming the former U.S. president adopts prejudiced policies. Dirceu said he does not believe the Brazilian people will hand over the Presidency to the opposition.

item.title: Bia Kicis critica “núcleo de inteligência” ligado ao PT e fala em censura digital
item.description: Deputy Bia Kicis (PL-DF) criticized the so-called 'Intelligence Nucleus' of the Lula government, accusing it of monitoring and censoring political speech on social media, linking the structure to the PT and Lula’s pre-campaign. She claimed the nucleus operates as an ideological and digital control tool, threatening freedom of expression. The statement was made on Tuesday, the 23rd, and gained traction in right-leaning media outlets.

item.title: Lula pede atenção com “piruetas na bicicleta” ao citar roubos de celular
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva launched the new phase of the Cell Phone Safe program, making it a permanent public policy and announcing the creation of the BNCR, a national database of stolen or lost cell phones. He urged Brazilians to be more cautious when using phones in public, warning about thieves approaching on bicycles performing 'stunts'. The BNCR integrates data from police, carriers, Anatel, and ABR Telecom, with 3.3 million IMEIs registered since 2020 and 272,000 devices recovered.

item.title: Petrobras fecha acordo com Pemex para explorar projetos no Golfo do México
item.description: Petrobras and Pemex signed a two-year memorandum of understanding to jointly explore oil and gas projects in the Gulf of Mexico, focusing on deep-water reserves underexplored on the Mexican side. The agreement comes as Pemex seeks to reverse years of debt and declining production, while Petrobras brings its global expertise in deepwater offshore exploration. President Lula had previously noted that Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum requested Petrobras' assistance for such exploration, emphasizing regional integration amid tensions with the United States.

item.title: Márcio França vai se reunir com Lula e Haddad para tentar definir eleição em São Paulo
item.description: Márcio França (PSB-SP) will meet with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and former minister Fernando Haddad to define electoral strategy in São Paulo, aiming to prevent Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) from winning in the first round. França seeks to launch his own candidacy to draw votes from Kataguiri, Serra, and even Tarcísio, though the São Paulo PT remains skeptical due to the risk of splitting the left-wing vote and jeopardizing the Senate ticket.

item.title: Tebet diz que vice mulher em chapa de Flávio Bolsonaro “não muda nada”
item.description: Simone Tebet (PSB) states that selecting a woman as vice president on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) ticket changes nothing, as he follows his father Jair Bolsonaro's path and represents civilizational setbacks. She emphasizes that female representation is essential only when paired with substantive policy proposals, and advocates for a balanced ticket with Fernando Haddad in São Paulo, where she, Marina Silva, and Márcio França are being considered for vice.
